availability_note: 1X takes pre-orders on its order page against a fully refundable deposit and says US deliveries start in 2026. The order page offers NEO either as a monthly subscription or to own.

named_models.name: Redwood AI
named_models.role_note: 1X calls Redwood AI NEO's vision language model for learning and performing chores around the house, and says it is the AI model that lets NEO help around the home, moving, perceiving, and interacting with the world autonomously.

named_models.name: Redwood AI reinforcement-learning controller
named_models.role_note: 1X says Redwood AI's latest reinforcement-learning controller gives NEO its mobility: walking in any direction, sitting, standing, kneeling, and climbing stairs using stereo vision.

named_models.name: 1X World Model
named_models.role_note: 1X says the 1X World Model lets NEO anticipate the outcomes of robot actions and their consequences on the world, and that it now serves as NEO's cognitive core, letting it generalise to tasks it has not seen.

hardware.compute: A 1X NEO Cortex chipset (Nvidia Jetson Thor), which the product page rates at up to 2070 FP4 TFLOPS of AI compute.
hardware.sensors: Dual 8.85MP 90Hz stereo fisheye cameras, four beamforming microphones, and linkwise differential IMUs.
hardware.actuation: Low-inertia tendon drives, which 1X calls 1X Tendon Drive. The product page lists 22 degrees of freedom in each hand, 7 in each arm, 3 in the neck, 2 in the spine, and 6 in each leg, with a walking speed of 1.4 m/s.
hardware.power: An 842 Wh battery with a 4-hour run time. 1X says NEO plugs itself in when it needs a charge, and that a quick charge takes 6 minutes per hour of run time.

developer_access: 1X documents no way to run your own model or policy on NEO.
terms_note: The legal page publishes 1X's Pre-Order Terms. They say a buyer who is invited to order must agree to Terms of Sale that are presented at the time of purchase, so the full sale terms are not published ahead of an order. The Terms of Use link, 1x.tech/terms-and-conditions, returned a 404 at review. The order page names a 3-year warranty with the ownership option.

terms_evidence.scope: Pre-order terms on the legal page

not_verified: The models named here, and what they do, are 1X's own claims; the Atlas has not verified them. Every source is a 1X web page that 1X can change at any time.
